## Activity

During March 2024, River Outreach recorded 56 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total should be read alongside the quality and grading measures below, which summarise the recorded results without adding further interpretation.

## Image quality

Of the recorded captures, 12 were marked ungradable by graders. The ungradable rate was 21.4. This result is retained as the reported rate for the site and month. Recurring camera issues should continue to be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

There were 4 results graded referable. The median grading lag was 0. Together, these measures describe the grading outcome for River Outreach during March 2024. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk, supporting consistent documentation of equipment concerns and helping maintain a clear operational record alongside the activity, image quality, and grading results.
